_: It.16b: Travel template + Sandbox-at-specific-ref demo. NPC starts inside the Bannered Mare; Travel package targets `debugWhiterunOrigin` (Skyrim.esm:0x0567F7 — the marker that `coc whiterun` spawns at), and a Sandbox package anchored at the SAME ref so once he arrives he hangs around the marketplace. Engine evaluates packages in list order; Travel runs first (he'll try to leave the inn and walk to Whiterun's centre), then Sandbox keeps him there.

packages._: Travel template (Skyrim.esm:0x016FAA) has 3 slots — place / rideHorse / preferPath.
Same Sandbox shape as It.16a, but anchored at a specific vanilla ref (debugWhiterunOrigin) instead of NearSelf — demonstrates the `location` ref path of SandboxSpec. Runs after Travel completes.

npcs.name: ModForge Traveler
npcs._packages: Order matters — engine picks the first matching package. Travel runs while he hasn't arrived; once at the destination, Sandbox takes over.

placements._: Spawn inside the Bannered Mare (the It.16a-confirmed arena). Travel should walk him out and across town to the Whiterun-origin marker; if cross-cell pathfinding fails the engine falls through to the Sandbox package's location anchor.
